csv_scope_of_work: The Kanawha County Commission (KCC) is accepting Expressions of Interest and Statements of Qualifications from qualified engineering and architecture consulting firms detailing the firm s qualifications, technical expertise, management and staffing capabilities, references, and prior experience for the Shawnee Sports Complex Expansion Project. The Shawnee Sports Complex is a premier multi-use sports complex located in Institute, West Virginia. The complex includes six collegiate turf multipurpose fields, four collegiate baseball fields, and 27 acres of additional grass fields. The complex routinely hosts several large youth sporting tournaments, including events with hundreds of teams and thousands of daily visitors.
